name: Okinawa

flag.description: A red disc with a white ring inside it, on a white field.
flag.symbolism: The white ring is an O for Okinawa.

hook: Okinawa looks like Japan's red sun with a white O punched into it: O for Okinawa.
trivia: Okinawa was the independent Ryukyu Kingdom until Japan annexed it in 1879, and was under US administration from 1945 until 15 May 1972.
The emblem was first meant to be blue, white and red, but looked too like the All Japan Kendo Federation's mark; it was blue and white for a few months before turning red in October 1972.
